recordedProductIssues: Phone panel notice flush against the top edge of the frame, clipped by the panel border

defects.problem: Same two-pane layout holds for a long time with only the caption changing; little visual progress.
defects.fix: Cut the hold shorter or move the highlight to different regions of the phone UI per caption.

defects.problem: Phone panel's top (yellow notice) touches the panel edge, and a floating yellow bar sits just left of it; reads as misalignment.
defects.fix: Remove the bar or attach it to the panel; add top padding.

defects.problem: Link row: share URL partly hidden by a redaction box that leaves a short stub on a second line, looks sloppy.
defects.fix: Extend the mask over the full token line.

defects.problem: Left screen shows unredacted fake card and email; fine as synthetic, but the dense caption line is long.

oneLineVerdict: Honest and complete, but static with a clipped phone panel and a stray yellow bar.
